action: Added a second navigation axis: ten problem-based product tags, a hub page, and links from the homepage and the main menu
reviewer_item: 3 - add a 'Shop by Problem' entry point
why: The catalogue is organised by what a thing is - a bowl, a harness, a bed. Nobody arrives wanting a front-clip harness; they arrive wanting their dog to stop pulling.

copy.per_tag: 130-180 words of buying guidance in the term description, same standard as a category archive, plus SureRank title and description
honesty: barks-too-much leads with enrichment and says plainly that boredom and separation barking are not deterrent problems
pulls-on-the-lead excludes the retractable lead the site stocks, and says why
runs-off says neither tracker type replaces a microchip
hates-the-car says a seat-belt tether is distraction control, not crash protection
bad-breath says brushing is the only part that reliably works and that a sudden change of smell is a vet visit
copy.inclusion_rule: A tag exists only where the catalogue can honestly answer the problem. Four products with a straight explanation beats twelve padded out with anything loosely related.

surfaces.menu: Added as item 2, after Home. Twelve items now. A complete args array was passed to wp_update_nav_menu_item - it clears every field it is not given, which is how Contact Us lost its URL on an earlier pass.

thumbnails.method: Seeded from the highest-selling product carrying each tag
thumbnails.overridden: runs-off and bad-breath. The seed put a squeaky ball on the dental page and the same training lead on both pulling and running off.
thumbnails.rule: Check the picture matches the problem when you add a tag

sitemap.problem: product_tag did not appear in sitemap_index.xml after the terms were created. Neither the cron hook nor a cache purge fixed it - SureRank builds the index from JSON chunk files written by batch processes.
sitemap.trap: Running Sync_Taxonomies for product_tag alone rewrote the index to contain ONLY the tag sitemap. Products, pages, posts and categories all vanished from it. Recovered by running the full class set.
sitemap.fix: Sync::get_instance()->run_batch_synchronously( generate_classes() ) then finalize_cache_generation(), inside an output buffer - the batch logs megabytes

side_finding.per_post_robots: Noindex is NOT part of the serialized surerank_settings_general array. It is a separate meta key, surerank_settings_post_no_index, set to the string 'yes'. That is how /start is noindexed.
side_finding.unfixed: The two SureForms form CPT singles are thin duplicates of the pages embedding them and still render index, follow. Neither the global no_index list nor the per-post key changes it; SureForms renders those singles through its own template. The global setting did drop the form archive from the sitemap, so it was kept.

verification.hub: HTTP 200, 10 rows, 10 links, thumbnails and CSS present
verification.archives: All 10 tag archives HTTP 200, descriptions render as 3-4 paragraphs, products list (chews-everything shows all 12), correct SEO titles and canonicals
verification.robots_sweep: homepage, hub, /store/, a guide, a category archive, a tag archive and a product all index, follow. /start remains noindex, follow.
verification.menu: 12 items, every title and URL intact
